items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tracked her down. People kept saying, “She’s dead.” No. Then I tracked her down.

ctx.x: Tracked her down. People kept saying, “She’s dead.” No. Then I tracked her down.
She was around then. O.k. So there’s some names . . . Are there any others before you that, maybe names like that you can now be the voice for the voiceless, so to speak.
